scene: The taffy crane's brass control panel hums with sticky mechanical life.
picture: First-person close-up view of the taffy crane control console. Splatters of glossy pink candy glaze dot the steel plating. On the left sits a thick brass dial set to zero, in the centre is a sticky striped toggle switch, and on the right gleams a round copper chime button waiting to be pressed.
shown: a giant knurled brass dial clicking at speed zero on the left
a striped red switch coated in hardened sugar in the centre
a gleaming copper chime button labeled alarm on the right

variants.scene: Pink, sugary goo drips down the brass controls of the taffy crane.
The warm air smells of melted sugar as steam drifts from pipes above.
Puffs of smoke rise behind the gum-splattered control deck before you.
